title: Last Lost Day of a Larkspur-Side Wire Return: Closing and Funding Schedule Note
content:
**Rule.** For a Closing and Funding returned-wire refund, the last lost day is set as follows: where a Larkspur-side return occurred and the wire that funded the loan went out later than the last day of Larkspur's re-send standard, it is the last day of the standard, and the later unfunded days are not lost days; where a Larkspur-side return occurred and the wire that funded the loan went out no later than the last day of the standard, it is the day before the disbursement date; otherwise there is no last lost day.

Larkspur's re-send standard is the re-send days plus the re-review days plus the relock days, counted in business days Monday through Friday starting with the day after the return date; with no days the standard ends on the return date itself.

A wire return is Larkspur-side when the settlement agent rejected a wire whose amount differs from the amount of the wire that funded the loan (Larkspur's wrong amount), or when Larkspur recalled the wire because a prior-to-funding item was open (a return marked as funding conditions unmet). The wire that funded the loan is the outgoing wire sent on the disbursement date, and the return looked at is the closing's latest wire return.

## Both sides of the standard (hypothetical: return on Tuesday the 5th, a 3-business-day standard ending Friday the 8th)

| Funding wire sent on | Last lost day |
|---|---|
| Monday the 11th (later than the 8th) | Friday the 8th; the 9th and 10th are not lost days |
| Friday the 8th (no later) | Thursday the 7th |
| Thursday the 7th (no later) | Wednesday the 6th |
| no Larkspur-side return | none |
